details: Invalid as stated.  The family $\mathcal H=\{\{1\},\{2\}\}$ has oriented diameter $0$ and Hamming radius $1$.
proof: As above, this two-concept family has no projection containing an empty/full pair, so $\mathrm D^+(\mathcal H)=0$.  It is contained in the radius-one Hamming ball centered at $\varnothing$, and no radius-zero ball contains both concepts; therefore $\mathrm B(\mathcal H)=1$.  The claimed positive-factor lower bound is false.
name: Oriented Diameter / Hamming Radius
